answer: Re-attestations are stored in river and zenith lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Verification costs 9 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 598 account sybil into a 13 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
